results.question: How do I pay a failed debit?

answer.title: From the official help pages
answer.message: These are saved source explanations, not a live AI answer.

blocks.title: Deduction and completion are different
blocks.text: A bank debit does not by itself confirm unit allotment. Groww says order processing and unit allocation can take up to 5–6 business days depending on the fund and payment method. Check the order status; do not make another payment just because the first one is unclear.

blocks.title: Check the payment status first
blocks.text: Groww lists insufficient balance and bank payment-system issues as possible reasons for a failed debit. If the debit has failed, its help page describes a Pay option on the dashboard. This does not establish why your payment failed or whether that option is available for you.
